changelog:
Initial public release with end-to-end diffraction/scattering data processing powered by pyFAI.

- Supports calibration (.poni file generation), 1D/2D integration, batch and streaming workflows.
- Handles GIWAXS/fiber modes, chi/azimuthal profiles, sector/cake integration, and large HDF5/Eiger datasets.
- Provides error-aware integration with uncertainty propagation and advanced corrections (mask, dark, flat, polarization).
- Includes installation guidance for Python and pyFAI environments.
- Features bilingual (EN/中文) prompts, best practices, and robust command templates for the full workflow.
